Ft.bar_b_note: Neither side shows any open sky, cloud sea or stratified cliff, so the fight reads as a bare grey (A) or torch-lit night (B) plaza under a HUD covering a third of the frame, not a Palworld-finish sky-realm event.

Pb.bar_b_note: B's mottled, grounded python comes close to the naturalistic bar, but A's toy-like two-tone stripes and its faint poses floating high above the shadow, plus the flat stage in both, keep it short of shipping-game finish.

Vy.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing, readable elder with expressive eyes and a natural green-brown outfit that sits next to Palworld's stylised NPCs, though it leans more cartoon than the key art's stylised realism.

Jg.bar_b_note: Both sides are a murky brown-black forest floor with no purple storm sky, lightning or moss colour, a barely visible player creature and flat magenta floor shapes; A also loses frames to the camera sitting inside canopy or trunks.

Gt.bar_b_note: The meadow, sky and mountains hold up, but a single free-standing panel (pale and blank in B, framed but still card-thin in A) does not read as Palworld-style base building.

top_changes.change: Relight and reframe the Stormwood and Cloudreach fights: purple storm sky and lightning plus a lifted exposure with rim light on both fighters in Stormwood; a bright open sky and cloud-sea backdrop for the Veyra arena; camera collision that keeps canopy and trunks out of frame; the HUD side panels slimmed so they stop covering the action

Replace the flat magenta/white floor rings and text-driven tells with telegraphs made of real objects (gathering lightning, cracking stone, gusts of debris), give hits visible impacts, and cap the ally's on-screen size so the opponent and the player stay visible

Build a real homestead wall piece with depth: a thick timber frame, plank or wattle-and-daub infill with texture, a top cap or beam, a stone footing in a distinct material, and pieces that snap into runs rather than a single card
